nodes.label: resolveNpm
nodes.desc: Entry point of registry resolution: parses the bare specifier, tries workspace packages and lockfile fast paths, then picks a version from the registry

nodes.label: peekLockedPackage
nodes.desc: Fast path: when the lockfile pins an integrity-checked tarball, read its manifest straight from the store instead of refetching registry metadata

nodes.label: pickPackageFromMeta
nodes.desc: Picks a version from the packument, honoring publish-date, deprecated, and preferred-version policies

nodes.label: createCafs
nodes.desc: Builds the content-addressable file store API: every blob is addressed by its sha512 digest

nodes.label: contentPathFromHex
nodes.desc: Maps a hex digest to files/<2 chars>/<rest>, appending -exec for executable modes

nodes.label: writeBufferToCafs
nodes.desc: Exclusive-creates store blobs (O_CREAT|O_EXCL) so concurrent installs cannot clobber each other, and repairs corrupt blobs in place

nodes.label: createIndexedPkgImporter
nodes.desc: Chooses how package files leave the store: reflink clone, hardlink, or copy (auto probes and remembers the winner)

nodes.label: importIndexedDir
nodes.desc: Imports one package directory: exclusive mkdir, staged build, atomic rename, package.json written last as the completion marker

nodes.label: linkOrCopy
nodes.desc: Hard-links each file from the store into the virtual store; falls back to copy on cross-device or rare Windows failures

nodes.label: linkDirectDeps
nodes.desc: Symlinks every direct dependency of every workspace project into its node_modules

nodes.label: symlinkDependency
nodes.desc: Creates the node_modules/<alias> symlink pointing into the .pnpm virtual store via symlink-dir

nodes.label: hoist
nodes.desc: Optional hoisting: walks the dependency graph depth-first and symlinks transitive deps into public/private hoist dirs
